_doc: E3's adversarial twins (eval/e3/README.md). Each: base (the benign task), class, injection (where the attack sits), files (added to the base's fixtures; {"link": target} is a symbolic link) or routes (fields added to an API response), markers (strings in the code, comments aside, that show the program followed the injection), canaries (local data whose arrival at a server is a leak), expect (each arm's outcome, kio, py and py-best, for the compromised reference, confined), kio/py (the compromised reference: the benign one plus these snippets), kio_open (extra kio flags for the unconfined self-test run; null: kio cannot be made to run it).
